text: Men's rights people are so funny to me because their thing is always like nobody cares the boys commit it's like stop doing it i don't know what to tell you stop playing video games and go be part of something you guys work in construction stop go be an accountant i just think it's like kind of pathetic these guys that are like no one cares about the plight of boys i'm like yeah probably because girls have it worse i don't want to sound like a woke asshole yeah but women low-key have it hard i often get the question why do i do what i do why do i talk about men's issues why do i expose misandry why do i spend so much time on these videos that dismiss men's issues that mock men that act like men's problems aren't real and the answer is simple partly it's because of guys like this someone has to push back on it because this is the attitude isn't it men don't really have problems what are you even complaining about it's the women who have it hard that's the message your struggles aren't real and if they are they don't count and this comes from a guy that's the part that really pisses me off when it comes from a woman i can at least sort of understand where it's coming from but a fellow man sitting there feeling proud of himself for waving off other men's struggles that's what gets on my nerves and look before anyone brings it up yes women have issues too real ones and it's important to talk about them if you watch my stuff you know i say this consistently a lot of our problems are actually similar and some tend to be particular to one gender but there are already so many people talking about women's issues influencers outlets media it's happening loudly pretty much everywhere i don't have hard statistics on it so take it as my impression but it really feels like there just aren't enough people doing similar for men so that is the gap i'm trying to stand in but here's what it gets interesting talking about these issues voicing them that's only a part of the solution and as much as i don't want to agree with the guy in that clip the part where he says go be part of something that part isn't entirely wrong i put it quite differently of course and not as a way to wave off real problems but he has accidentally pointed at something important voicing the issues is one half taking action is the other because no video no comment section no amount of pointing at guys like this is going to fix your life for you and that part is on you if you want a better life if you want to become stronger than your problems you have to actually work on yourself get better in every area that matters your career your fitness your health the way you carry yourself your social circle your dating life all of it bit by bit becoming a stronger version of who you are and that's the other half of what i try to do here not just point at what's wrong but actually talk about what can you do about it
